findings.source_quote: …there stood by me this night the angel of God, whose I am, and whom I serve, Saying, Fear not, Paul… –Acts 27:23-24.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the clause faithfully into natural Indonesian preserving the original meaning: that Paul is saying the angel declared he (Paul) belongs to God and serves Him. For example: “…malam itu berdiri dekat aku malaikat Allah, yang adalah kepunyaan-Nya, dan yang aku layani, katanya: Jangan takut, Paulus… –Kisah Para Rasul 27:23-24.” (Preserve the verse reference and placement.)
findings.translation_quote: …malam itu berdiri dekat aku malaikat Allah, yang aku punak, dan yang aku layani, berkata, Jangan takut, Paulus… –Kisah Para Rasul 27:23-24.

findings.suggested_fix: Translate the article title into standard Bahasa Indonesia, preserving theology and style. For example: "Pelabuhan Istirahat" or the translator's established rendering used in the text ("Pelabuhan yang Diinginkan" is used as a heading in the translation). Ensure the translated title replaces the English title in translation.title.

findings.source_quote: It is our own faulty premonitions that pound our soul and prevent us from entering the portal of peace.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix mistranslation/typo into clear Indonesian that preserves the source meaning. For example: "Justru prasangka/praduga salah kita sendiri yang menghantam jiwa kita dan menghalangi kita memasuki gerbang damai." Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation.
findings.translation_quote: Jemakan prasangka kita sendiri-lah yang memukul jiwa kita dan menghalangi kita memasuki gerbang damai.
